Bollywood Films Show Strong Box Office Performance Globally

Several Bollywood films, including 'Welcome to the Jungle' and 'Main Vaapas Aaunga', have demonstrated robust box office performance in their opening weeks and weekends. 'Welcome to the Jungle' is nearing the Rs 100 crore mark worldwide, with a significant surge in earnings on its third day. 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' has also achieved notable success, surpassing Rs 70 crore globally and breaking its own daily records.
